failed_reason: Insufficient real curated photos. Only 1 real, verifiable photo of the business could be obtained in this session (a gray Toyota RAV4 parked outside a residence, saved as assets/raw/google-photo-1-rav4.jpg), sourced via a stable Google Business Profile photo reference (https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/p/AF1QipOIbKwGfNnDOzzVazehnBdcKY7bBOfA-3YCcoYA, verified downloadable and a real JPEG with EXIF software=Google) embedded in a directory clone (sswash.com). This appears to be the single 'primary/cover' photo Google exposes to third-party scrapers for this listing; no gallery of additional photos could be reached. All other real-photo channels were tried and blocked in this sandbox: (1) Yelp business page (yelp.com/biz/hands-of-grace-mobile-detailing-mascotte, indexed title shows '28 Photos') returns HTTP 403 from DataDome bot protection on every attempt (WebFetch, curl with Chrome UA + full browser headers, curl via r.jina.ai reader proxy: all blocked, r.jina.ai itself hit a Cloudflare challenge). (2) Facebook page (facebook.com/HandsofGraceMobileDetailing, has a /photos/ and /reels/ path per search index) redirects to the login wall on every fetch method tried (plain curl, curl with facebookexternalhit UA following redirects, mbasic.facebook.com, WebFetch, Facebook's own oEmbed endpoint returned a generic error). (3) lh3.googleusercontent.com/gps-cs-s/... session-bound Google photo URLs surfaced by other aggregators (detailingfinder.com) return HTTP 403 (expired/session-bound token, not fetchable independently of a live Maps session). (4) No Instagram account for this specific business was confirmed (Instagram's web_profile_info API is globally rate-limited/auth-walled in this session for every handle variant tried, and no handle was found associated with this business in search results; unrelated 'Grace' detailing/beauty accounts exist but do not match). (5) BBB profile is Cloudflare-challenge protected via curl (readable only via WebFetch, which returned business/officer data but no photos). (6) Google Maps place page fetched directly (by place_id ChIJj_fz8iIuM4oRrRzNXkzk8vY, decoded from a Google embed URL found on sswash.com) did not resolve to the business without a live browser session (returned a generic USA-centered preview, no photo references). (7) Other directories checked (zaubee.com: Cloudflare-blocked; bestcarwashfinders.com, detailingfinder.com: only generated OG placeholder images, no real photos; wearedetailers.com, mobiledetailing.io, self-servicecarwash.com: no matching listing found / connection blocked). Per PIPELINE.md Fase 1 point 4 and Fase 3 point 5, fewer than 5 verified real photos means the build should not be forced; this matches the precedent of output/alpha-mobile-detail-st-petersburg (same niche, same failure mode: real business confirmed, contact info confirmed, but Yelp/Facebook/Google photo galleries all inaccessible from this sandbox). Build (content.json/index.html), gate.py and outreach-draft.md were NOT created, per instructions to stop at this point rather than force a degraded site.

website_check.result: All 4 domains fail DNS resolution. Confirmed independently via WebFetch (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND for both the .com and the llc.com variant, a different network path than the blocked curl/proxy layer, so this is a clean non-existence signal, not a sandbox artifact) AND via the BBB Business Profile, which lists no website field at all (only a Facebook link) for this BBB-accredited (A+, accredited since 11/14/2025) listing.
website_check.caution: Two directory-clone sites (detailingfinder.com and sswash.com) both display 'Web: http://www.handsofgracemobiledetailingllc.com/' -- but sswash.com's page for this business is a near-verbatim copy of detailingfinder.com's page (identical 'Black-owned and LGBTQ+ friendly' boilerplate phrase, identical claimed website line, identical review-count figure of 34), meaning these are ONE non-independent, unreliable source repeating a claim that fails live DNS verification. Treated as a directory artifact/error, NOT a real website, consistent with the arahis-bakery precedent (never trust an aggregator-claimed domain without independent DNS/HTTP verification).

rating_source: NOT confirmed via a live Google Maps/Business fetch in this session (Google Maps place pages require a live browser session to resolve reviews; direct place_id fetch returned a generic unresolved preview). The 4.9/64 figure was the initial discovery datum (cited only as 'Google' via a search snippet) and was cross-checked against ONE genuinely independent second source found this session: bestcarwashfinders.com, which explicitly states '4.9 stars' and '64 Google reviews' with matching address/phone, and is not part of the detailingfinder.com/sswash.com clone family (different template, different generated OG image, different copy). That gives two independently-templated sources agreeing on 4.9/64 attributed to Google, which is treated as reasonably corroborated but still NOT equivalent to a live Google Maps read.
rating_conflicts: A separate, non-independent source pair (detailingfinder.com and its near-duplicate sswash.com, which mirror each other's boilerplate almost verbatim, see website_check.caution) states 5.0 stars / 34 reviews instead -- a materially different, lower review count from the same underlying Google listing at a different point in time or via a different scrape. Two OTHER platforms show their own distinct, smaller, platform-native counts that are legitimate but not substitutes for the Google figure: Yelp search-index snippet shows 5.0 stars / 2 Yelp-native reviews; a Facebook search-index snippet shows '100% recommendation' from 6 Facebook-native reviews. None of these were used as the primary rating; the report below uses 4.9/64 with the caveats above stated explicitly, per the honesty requirement.

services_research.summary_only: No itemized price list was found published anywhere (expected: this niche group commonly does not publish prices). Aggregator copy consistently describes: interior & exterior detailing, paint protection & waxing, stain & odor removal, flexible scheduling for home/office mobile service. BBB categorizes the business under Mobile Auto Detailing, Auto Detailing, and RV Cleaning Services. Per pipeline variant adaptada rule, prices would have been rendered as 'se cotiza, escribenos' had the build proceeded -- not fabricated.
